title: select_tool/select_template wired into document_write as an opt-in auto-selector for template_id
goal: Close the gap: template_id already lets a caller name a template, but nothing ever picked one FOR the caller from the ask itself.
method: A legal-notice-shaped ask run three ways: the new flag omitted (baseline, unaffected), enabled with no explicit template (auto-selects legal_notice), and enabled alongside an explicit template_id (the caller's own choice still wins, no auto-select step fires).
results_prose: auto_select_template omitted (default): 'supported', no auto_select_template trace step -- today's exact behavior (outline from entity-grouping, no template). Enabled: 'supported', auto-selected tool='legal' template_id='legal_notice' (score=0.6346) from the ask alone, no template named by the caller. Enabled BUT with an explicit template_id also given: 'supported', zero auto_select_template step -- the caller's own explicit choice is never overridden.
conclusion: lab.common.doc_tools.select_tool/select_template -- EXP-082's own standalone entry point, never reachable from brain.reason -- now auto-selects a registered template for the document_write stage when the caller opts in (auto_select_template=True) and leaves template_id at its default. A caller who already names a template, or leaves the new flag at its default False, is completely unaffected.
scale_down: Two registered templates (legal, study, per EXP-082's own registry), one ask -- a proof the dispatch/precedence wiring works end to end, not a benchmark of select_tool/select_template's own matching accuracy at a larger template catalog (already measured in EXP-082).
follow_ups: No minimum-score floor: a low-confidence match still gets auto-selected rather than falling back to entity-grouping. EXP-082 itself never needed one (its own fixture always had a real match); a caller relying on auto_select_template for an ask that matches no registered template well would get a weak pick instead of the old entity-grouping fallback.
models_used: lab.common.real_encoders.bge_embed (bge cosine similarity) -- same mechanism select_tool/select_template already used in EXP-082, unchanged.
